The society was founded in 1936 as the International Society for Soil Mechanics and Foundation Engineering (ISSMFE). Karl Terzaghi, widely recognized as the father of soil mechanics, served as the first president.

After Terzaghi's tenure, the presidency passed to Arthur Casagrande, another pioneer in the field who made significant contributions to soil mechanics including the development of the Casagrande liquid limit test and various soil classification methods.
